depends_on: Milnor 1964 Betti-number bound for real algebraic sets
Cartwright-Sturmfels 2013 eigenvector count of a generic symmetric tensor
notes: Finiteness: B'_{n,m} <= B_{n,m} <= min(((m-1)^n-1)/(m-2), m(2m-1)^(n-1)/2). Outside Lean: everything (Milnor's bound applied to {p=0, |x|^2=1}, whose isolated points are components; perturbation of strict minima on the sphere to eigenvectors of a generic nearby tensor). Exact values (Conjecture 4.2, Problem N) not addressed.
